result.summary: Found 1 major visual issue: a restaurant card in the “Popular right now” section has a missing/broken image. Minor carousel edge truncation is present but likely expected scrolling behavior.

issues.description: The first “Popular right now” card for Tokumaru Ramen Bar shows a gray placeholder with a broken-image icon instead of the restaurant photo.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the image URL loads correctly, add a retry/fallback state, and use a branded placeholder or hide the image area until media is available.

issues.description: Cards and text at the right edge of horizontally scrolling sections are clipped, e.g. “Trattoria Piccol…” in “Fastest near you.”
issues.suggestion: This may be intentional for scroll affordance, but consider adding clearer edge fade/peek spacing so truncated content looks deliberate rather than cut off.
